firstPlayerRule: The player who bought a gaming console earliest becomes the first active player.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The active player rolls all five dice. Players normally fill in their grids simultaneously.
Compare when players first bought a console, rather than their most recent console purchase.
